title: Francisca Villagra Macías — CV
text:
Professional Summary
Product Owner and Information & Management Control Engineer with ten years of experience turning complex data and risk problems into production-grade digital products. I have led full product cycles (from strategic definition to end-user adoption) across retail, forestry and financial services, including six years at Experian under U.S. CFPB regulation. I manage product with hands-on knowledge of the technical stack: SQL, Python, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Tableau, and deployed machine learning models (K-Means, XGBoost) to production for risk scoring.

title: Francisca Villagra Macías — CV
text:
Beyond the Data
Beyond spreadsheets, SQL queries and agile methodologies, there is a person with many interests that shape my analytical perspective.
I am driven by an insatiable curiosity 🔍: I am always trying to understand how things work, explore new technologies or learn something completely different just for the joy of it. That same spark makes me an avid reader 📚, with a weakness for always collecting more books than time allows me to read.
When I switch off my screen, you will find me enjoying good food🍳, experimenting with homemade recipes or discovering new flavors, or occasionally going for a run🏃‍♀️ to clear my mind and recharge.
Ultimately, I believe this combination of technical rigor and eclectic curiosity is what makes every project (and every day) interesting ✨.

“Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood. Now is the time to understand more, so that we may fear less.”
— Marie Curie

section: Un poco más allá de los datos
text:
Un poco más allá de los datos
Fuera de las hojas de cálculo, las consultas SQL y las metodologías ágiles, hay una persona con múltiples intereses que alimentan mi perspectiva analítica.
Me define una curiosidad inagotable 🔍: siempre estoy buscando entender cómo funcionan las cosas, explorar nuevas tecnologías o aprender algo totalmente distinto por puro gusto. Esa misma chispa me convierte en una lectora empedernida 📚, con la debilidad de acumular siempre más libros de los que el tiempo permite leer.
Cuando apago la pantalla, me encuentras disfrutando de la buena cocina🍳 tanto experimentando con recetas caseras como descubriendo nuevos sabores o, de vez en cuando, saliendo a correr🏃‍♀️ para poner la mente en blanco y recargar energía.
Al final, creo que esa combinación de orden técnico y curiosidad ecléctica es la que hace que cada proyecto (y cada día) sea interesante ✨.

“En la vida no hay que temer a nada, solo comprenderlo. Ahora es el momento de comprender más, para que temamos menos.”
— Marie Curie
